name: Test Repair PR
description: Parse Conduit test results, classify failures, propose repair actions, and produce PR Draft structure after validation.

verificationSteps: Classify each failure using stdout, stderr, and exitCode.
Tie repair suggestions to changed files or missing commands with evidence.
Do not invent business behavior while suggesting repairs.

safeDefaults: If output is incomplete, request rerun with captured stdout, stderr, and exitCode.
If failure is business assertion mismatch, route to the originating requirement Skill.
confirmationDefaults: PR Draft should list tests run and known failures honestly.

forbiddenChanges: Business logic decisions not present in taskSpec or originating Skill
successCriteria: Failure analysis classifies stdout, stderr, and exitCode evidence.
Repair suggestions are scoped and routed to the correct Skill when business behavior is involved.
PR Draft includes summary, changed files, tests run, failures, and risk notes.
